lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately vertical columns and horizontal rows along the visible lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a grid-like structural pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank showing a sharp vertical luminance transition from high-intensity (dorsal) to low-intensity shadow (ventral).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The first dorsal fin exhibits significant truncation and an irregular apex; a dark, elevated nodular mass is visible on the dorsal midline immediately anterior to the fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated silhouettes (commensal fish) visible in the water column below the posterior-ventral region of the shark.
